d: Very long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a small side braid. Sharp, narrow deep blue eyes with a calm expression on a youthful, mature face. Slender build wearing a dark navy blue tailored blazer and matching mini-skirt with purple accents, paired with a white collared shirt, a navy blue tie, sheer black tights, and pointed black ankle boots. Signature details include a purple bow at the collar, a white identification badge clipped to the waist, a navy blue armband on the left arm, and a translucent purple crystalline energy effect surrounding the left hand.
